metadata.title: Learned stabilization of incompressible flow: trained models and numerical evidence
metadata.description: Trained coefficient models and numerical evidence accompanying Learned Stabilization of Incompressible Flow: Adaptivity, Reliability and Deployment Cost, by Ehsan Akrami and Yan Delaure. Version 0.1.1 archives eight pressure45 model/control maps, five earlier 58-action and four expanded 62-action coefficient candidates, 45 qualified training teachers, 90 available predictor feature payloads and 104 indexed train/validation/fresh positions. Three numerical archives provide screened pressure saved fields and all 13 expanded physical readbacks plus pressure-representation oracles and adverse coupled controls. A standalone finite binary64 linear-response certificate and saved-field inference tests are included. Failed outcomes and the limits of conditional accuracy gains are retained. General ML reliability and equal-cost superiority are not established. The historical 37-tier dossier is not all distributed. Core FEM/fluid solver, training implementation and native binaries are excluded; this supports inference and saved-data replay, not native PDE reproduction. The associated manuscript remains under author review. The three numerical archive bytes are unchanged from the checksum-verified draft. This metadata patch changes no trained coefficient or scientific result.
